info.title: SYNTHORA coingecko-crypto-price-history
info.description: Historical daily price, market-cap and volume time-series for a coin in any fiat currency from CoinGecko's keyless market_chart endpoint (JSON). Serves autonomous crypto-vs-fiat trend agents, backtesting bots, and agent-to-agent analytics needing multi-day price series without a key. Pay-per-call via x402 on Base. No charge on upstream failure.
